name: SAS Language Date, Time, and Interval Semantics
description: Comprehensive specification of SAS date/time storage, INTCK, INTNX, formats, informats, and datetime arithmetic.
when_to_retrieve: When translating SAS date arithmetic (date + 30) or interval functions (INTCK, INTNX) to Python or SQL
when_not_to_retrieve: When SAS DATA step contains no date or datetime operations
retrieval_guidance: SAS dates are integers representing days since Jan 1, 1960. SAS INTNX('MONTH', date, 1, 'BEGINNING') computes the first day of the next month.
